text:
```yaml
name: Validate Dotfiles Configuration

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          npm install -g shellcheck
          npm install -g fish-syntax-check

      - name: Run Shellcheck
        run: |
          find . -name "*.sh" | xargs shellcheck --external-sources

      - name: Run Fish Syntax Check
        run: |
          find . -name "*.fish" | xargs fish-syntax-check

      - name: Run Abbreviation Validation
        run: |
          ./scripts/validate_abbreviations.sh

      - name: Run Environment Variable Conflict Detection
        run: |
          ./scripts/detect_env_conflicts.sh

      - name: Run Symlink Integrity Verification
        run: |
          stow --dry-run .

      - name: Run Dependency Availability Checks
        run: |
          brew bundle check

      - name: Run Git Functionality Test
        run: |
          ./scripts/test_git_functions.sh

      - name: Run Fix Mode Validators
        run: |
          ./scripts/run_validators.sh --fix

      - name: Run Report Mode Validators
        run: |
          ./scripts/run_validators.sh --report

      - name: Upload Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: validation-report
          path: ./validation_report.txt
```
